description: What Isoba showed on any working day since 1990-01-01: the four instruments with zones, every sensor, the eight filters (since 2006), the yield curve and the four credit inputs — computed point-in-time from data published by that day. Use for "what did it show before 2008 / on the day of COVID?".

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; a weekend or holiday gives the previous working day
